scope: Before any adapted-model development screen or final-test output; training NLL has already been inspected.
reason: The planned three-rank learning comparison still needs a learning rate if both rank32 pilots fail screen gates.
learning_rate_fallback: If no rank32 LR pilot passes, use5e-5 for the already planned rank8 and128 runs. This conservative fallback is partly informed by the observed development NLL and the original smaller-LR preference.
rank_stage: Include the5e-5 rank32 result for reporting, but a failed gate makes it ineligible. Apply unchanged gates/epoch rules to ranks8/128; choose only among passing adapters.
all_ranks_fail: Recommend the unadapted base. To complete the learning/control exercise, use the lowest observed development-NLL nominated candidate (ties:smaller rank,lower LR) for descriptive-only seed43 repeat and BF16 control. These do not override base recommendation.
interpretation: Gate failures are findings about behavior under continued training, not results to suppress. The planned rank comparison tests whether capacity changes that behavior.
